rows.summary: Autonomous systems increasingly utilize multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) to pursue self-generated goals. Recent developments, specifically Pareto-Conditioned Proximal Policy Optimization (PC-PPO) and FairDICE, provide mechanisms to learn non-dominated policy portfolios and handle constrained optimization, allowing navigation of reliability-efficiency frontiers without retraining. However, the field still faces fundamental challenges regarding non-convex optimization and strict convexity assumptions in scalarization functions.
